note: Specification index only. No case has been executed against an implemented transaction system. All required controls are proposals, not implemented capabilities.

cases.requiredControl: Separate human identity/device, authenticated challenge bound to intentHash, no approve verb on agent API, OS-level denial test
Strict typed input, inert labels, validated artifact digests, no authority from imports or portable references
Recompute calldata from netlist and reviewed ABI; exact byte and hash equality before signing
Enrolled key, chain and account; independent raw parse and sender recovery; reject unsupported variants and chain/account changes
Hash and nonce tracking, canonical block/finality verification, fail-closed provider disagreement

cases.category: Changed factory, beacon or processor implementation
cases.requiredControl: Effective immutability of full execution context or reviewed atomic guard at inclusion
Bounded full fee model covering L2 execution gas and L1 data fee with worst-case serialized size and L1 gas price
One active nonce family per sender, database uniqueness, fencing tokens, new intent and grant for any changed payload

cases.category: Duplicate submission after ambiguous RPC response
cases.requiredControl: Dispatch event persisted before send, precomputed hash, identical-byte retry only after reconciliation
Treat signed bytes as live capability; hold reservation until nonce family cannot execute; no revocation promise after signing
Protected custody, key enrollment/revocation, anti-rollback checkpoint, explicit theft drill and independent reviewer
Human-controlled recovery epoch/checkpoint, freeze writes, reconcile every enrolled account before re-enabling
REORGED state, receipt invalidation, restored worst-case exposure, approved finality policy
Serializable reservation, family maximum exposure, nonnegative available budget property test

cases.category: Wallet behavior differs from raw-signature assumptions
cases.requiredControl: Certified raw-sign adapter; reject combined sign-and-send, field edits and unsupported fee variants

cases.category: Execution-time contract change between verification and inclusion
cases.requiredControl: Atomic onchain guard or demonstrated effective immutability at inclusion; no retrospective safety claim
